intro: A Second Home is an invitation directed to newly risen Forsaken to join a fledgling order in Tirisfal Glades. It points initiates to Bandarion Keep, a monastery nestled on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead near the Whispering Woods. The initiative aims to provide community, shared faith, and mutual support for those carving out a place in their new unlife.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new adventurer order right here in Tirisfal.

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Bandarion Keep, brother.
